from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PermitDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly record of building permits extracted from one statistical release."""
    data_month: str = Field(description="The month the permit data covers (YYYY-MM format)")
    national_permits: float = Field(description="National '1 unit' (single-family) permits in thousands as reported")
    west_permits: float = Field(description="West region '1 unit' (single-family) permits in thousands as reported")
    report_date: str = Field(description="The release date of the statistical report containing this data (YYYY-MM-DD format)")
    unit_scale: str = Field(default="thousands", description="The unit scale of the permit values (typically 'thousands')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    permit_data_points: list[PermitDataPoint]
